entries.a384f26bbf8b9e01: The foundation of its business is the exclusive right to manufacture and sell Baskin-Robbins 31 Ice Cream in Japan and the exclusive right to use the trademark. It operates a store network of 1,061 franchisee stores and 41 company-operated stores, and manufactures in-house at two plants: the Fuji-Koyama Plant and the Kobe Miki Plant. The number of members of the membership app '31Club' exceeds 10 million, and member purchases account for 43.2% of total revenue.
